thread:
maria: Quick ask for the hw partners cost feed — we need final pricing + eviction/preempt profiles to finish the cost model. Ideally CSV with example rows and a short explanation of fields. Need by Tue EOD. cc @sam @akshay

sam: Can you list the exact fields you want? I've seen several vendors send different shapes.

akshay: Important: include empirical preemption rate (pct), typical eviction notice (seconds/minutes), and whether credit is automatic or manual. Also whether reserve tiers have guaranteed capacity or best-effort.

katie: Also need marketplace listing fees and any tiered rebates. That changes effective unit economics a lot.

ben: Here's a proposed minimal CSV spec we can ask partners to fill. Share this as the template:```
sku_id, vendor, region, instance_type, gpu_type, vcpu, memory_gb, price_per_hour_reserved, reserved_commit_months, reserved_capacity_guarantee_pct, price_per_hour_spot, spot_mean_usd, spot_stddev_usd, eviction_rate_pct_per_day, eviction_notice_seconds, eviction_credit_pct, marketplace_listing_fee_pct, volume_discount_tiers, effective_inference_cores, notes
```

ben: Example row (feel free to paste real examples):```
sku-xyz, FastCloud, us-west-2, p4d.24xlarge, A100-80GB, 96, 1536, 12.00, 12, 95, 3.50, 3.2, 0.8, 300, 20, 3.0, "0:0-100:0,100-500:5%", 48, "reserved has 95% guarantee; spot preempt mostly at night"
```

maria: Perfect — akshay can you add a short note on how we interpret eviction_credit_pct in the cost model? (is it immediate billing credit or applied as monthly rebate)

akshay: In our model we treat eviction_credit_pct as immediate credit on the hour of eviction, then reconcile monthly for edge cases. If vendor gives only monthly rebate numbers, we convert to equivalent hourly credit by dividing by expected evictions. Mention which one you provide.

liz: Please include expected availability windows (e.g., "business-hours-only" / 24x7 / weekend-limited) — that affects queuing and routing decisions.

katie: Legal note: vendors sometimes only offer credits if vm was live for X minutes. Ask them to include "min_running_seconds_for_credit" field if applicable.

partner-bot: Upload: vendor_templates/hw_pricing_feed_template_v3.csv (link) :white_check_mark:

sam: I can stitch incoming feeds into our modeling pipeline. Two asks: (1) include sample historical spot time series (CSV or link) if available, even 7 days is useful; (2) indicate timezone for availability windows.

ben: For marketplace fees include both listing fee and any per-invoice processing fee. Put as separate columns: marketplace_listing_fee_pct, marketplace_processing_fee_usd.

maria: Deadline reminder — ask partners to return the filled CSV + any sample spot time series by Tue EOD. We'll run sensitivity scenarios after that. If any partner cannot provide empirical eviction_rate_pct, ask for qualitative ranges (low/med/high) with assumptions.

akshay: One more modeling tip to vendors: if you provide percentiles for spot price (p10/p50/p90) that's better than mean+std. We'll convert but percentiles reduce tail-sensitivity ambiguity.

liz: Also ask whether reserved capacity can be released early and what the penalty curve is. Important for our commit hedge.

katie: I'll draft a short legal-friendly wording for the template about credits and eviction proof. Share in this thread before sending.

maria: Thanks everyone. Next check-in Wed 10am to review incoming feeds. I'll drop the final template + short email text in #partners-drafts shortly. :thumbsup:
